description:
Shift Plus knows no boundaries. Built on the foundation of a 6000 series 4 bar linkage frame with Plus geometry, the Shift Plus is the ultimate go anywhere do anything suspension bike. It features 130mm of travel on the rear, and 140mm of travel on the front with the new Revelation RC 27.5" Boost fork from RockShox. Add to that WTB Scraper i35 rims paired with WTB Ranger 27.5 x 2.8" tires and you'll have so much suspension you'll barely know the bumps were ever there. Shift Plus features Haro's Four-Bar linkage Plus design and has a progressive rear function with an additional central linkage and rear wheel pivots that work together to optimize shock performance. In addition, it creates increased rigidity between the front and rear triangle and isolates the rear shock from braking forces while keeping the suspension active when needed. A dropper post by TranzX adds convenience and Shimano SLX 7000 hydraulic disc brakes with fins stops this beast on a dime. Its semi complete Shimano XT 1X11 drive train pairs nicely with an FSA V-Drive Modular Boost crankset with 30T chain ring.
6061-T6 alloy 4-Bar Linkage frame, 27.5" Plus geometry, 130mm rear travel, Boost thru-axle dropouts
RS Monarch RL Solo Air rear shock w/ rebound adjuster & lockout
New RockShox Revelation RC 27.5" Boost fork, 35mm, 140mm travel
FSA V-Drive Modular Boost crankset w/ 30T alloy chainring
Shimano XT GS 11-spd Shadow Plus rear derailleur
Shimano XT 1x11-spd right shifter & 11-46T cassette
WTB Scraper 27.5" Plus i35 rims w/ TCS rim tape, Tubeless ready
WTB Ranger 27.5x2.8" tires, Dual DNA, TCS, Aramid Beads
Ritchey Trail alloy bars and stem w/ Trail WCS Lock-Ring grips
Shimano SLX 7000 Hydraulic disc brakes w/ fins
TranzX JD-YSP12 internal dropper post
